senses.definition_en: to indigenize in the style of the Mapuche people

examples.english: A legend says that a man came from the mythical Araucanía through the mountains to Mapuchize the plain with a woman from further away, from the Galician estuaries or from the Sicilian coasts.
examples.ref: 2004, Osvaldo Baigorria, Correrías de un infiel, page 129:
examples.text: Dice la leyenda que un hombre vino de la mítica Araucanía a través de las montañas para mapuchizar la llanura con una mujer de más lejos, de las rías gallegas o de las costas sicilianas.
examples.translation: A legend says that a man came from the mythical Araucanía through the mountains to Mapuchize the plain with a woman from further away, from the Galician estuaries or from the Sicilian coasts.

examples.english: When we speak of "Mapuchizing" hip hop and poetry, we refer to incorporating elements of our culture.
examples.ref: 2014, Jacob Rekedal, “El Hip-hop Mapuche en las Fronteras de la Expresión y el Activismo”, in Lengua y Literatura Indoamericana, volume 16, page 7:
examples.text: Cuando hablamos de "mapuchizar" el hip-hop y la poesía, nos referimos a incorporarlos como elementos a nuestra cultura.
examples.translation: When we speak of "Mapuchizing" hip hop and poetry, we refer to incorporating elements of our culture.

glosses: to indigenize in the style of the Mapuche people
